text.p: Salomon Brothers said in a research note it had initiated cover of Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy with a "hold" recommendation.
In the note headlined "Further North?" and dated November 14 but made available on Tuesday, Salomon said the stock had outperformed the Finnish market strongly.
The report quoted the share price 40.00 markka. At 1535/1335 GMT on Tuesday, Rautaruukki traded at 43.60 markka.
"Although we believe it has room for further gains as the steel market recovers the market has priced in much of Rautaruukki's superior potential," it said. @
Salomon's report valued Rautaruukki at just under six and around 4.50 percent times 1997 and 1998 earnings, around the lowest in the European sector alongside Hoogovens and British Steel.
